evidence.summary: Lower-cased name ending in a text type returns kind 'text' with the first 20 lines, decoded as UTF-8 with replacement.
Image types return kind 'image' with thumbnail URL /thumbs/<id>.png; no code generates the thumbnail.
Any other type returns kind 'none' with reason 'no preview for this type'.

architecture.backend: one pure function over a file dict with id, name and data

features.name: Text preview
features.description: Show the first lines of a text file.
features.observed_behaviour: For .txt/.md/.csv (case-insensitive) returns {kind: text, first_lines: up to 20 lines}; undecodable bytes are replaced.
features.business_logic: Type decided by file extension only; max 20 lines.
features.integration: needs read access to stored file bytes

features.name: Image thumbnail preview
features.description: Show a thumbnail for an image file.
features.observed_behaviour: For .png/.jpg/.gif returns {kind: image, thumbnail: /thumbs/<id>.png}. Nothing in the source creates or serves that thumbnail.
features.business_logic: Type decided by file extension only.
features.integration: needs a route that serves the image (or a thumbnail generator)

features.name: No-preview fallback
features.description: Tell the user a file type has no preview.
features.observed_behaviour: Returns {kind: none, reason: 'no preview for this type'}.

error_handling.behaviour: kind none with a reason, no error

error_handling.case: invalid UTF-8 in a text file

unknowns: How /thumbs/<id>.png is produced or served is not in the source; a thumbnail generator would need an imaging library (not available with the standard library only).
Where the file dict comes from (storage, permissions) is not in the source.
